findings.current: That was when the Skeleton King muttered bitterly to himself.
findings.defect: Makes his inward thought an action that begins at this point, rather than placing the next event during it.
findings.rationale: 내심 makes the muttering internal, and 그때였다 introduces the interruption that follows.
findings.replacement: As the Skeleton King thought bitterly to himself, it happened.
findings.source: 스켈레톤 킹이 내심 씁쓸하게 읊조린 그때였다.

findings.current: Under conditions so dire he’d have to borrow even a cat’s front paws, hearing things wasn’t strange at all.
findings.defect: The literal rendering obscures the idiom about being desperate for help.
findings.rationale: 고양이의 앞발이라도 빌리다 means seeking even the least useful help in desperate circumstances.
findings.replacement: With the odds so bad he’d take help from a cat if he could get it, hearing things wasn’t strange at all.
findings.source: 이렇듯 고양이의 앞발이라도 빌려야 하는 악조건 속에서 환청이 들리는 건 결코 이상한 일이 아니었다.

findings.current: It sounded unfamiliar, yet somehow it caught in his ear.
findings.defect: “Caught in his ear” is unnatural and loses the voice’s immediate, memorable familiarity.
findings.rationale: 귀에 착 하고 달라붙는 describes a voice that immediately catches and stays in the listener’s ear.
findings.replacement: It sounded unfamiliar, yet somehow it stuck with him the moment he heard it.
findings.source: 낯설게 느껴지면서도, 귀에 착 하고 달라붙는 듯한 저 음성.

findings.current: And seeing how they’d tied me up in the kind of turtle-shell bondage you only saw in certain Japanese videos, using ogre tendons—the famously tough kind—I realized whoever did it was completely insane.
findings.defect: “Bondage” makes the sexual implication more explicit than the source’s euphemistic reference to Japanese videos.
findings.rationale: The source names the tying pattern and hints at the videos without explicitly labeling the act.
findings.replacement: And they’d used those famously tough ogre tendons to tie me up in a turtle-shell pattern like something out of a certain kind of Japanese video. Whoever did this wasn’t just crazy.
findings.source: 심지어 그 질기다는 오우거 힘줄로 일본의 어느 영상물에서나 보던 귀갑 묶기를 해놓은 걸 보니, 미쳐도 보통 미친놈이 아니었다.

findings.current: Nor was it clear who needed to be careful.
findings.defect: Turns Jin’s pointed reversal of the warning into uncertainty.
findings.rationale: Jin is asserting that the seven, not he, are the ones who should be careful; he immediately cuts their number to six.
findings.replacement: And they’d picked the wrong person to warn.

findings.defect: “Clop” suggests a hoof rather than a footstep.
findings.rationale: 저벅 is the sound of a deliberate footstep as Jin advances.

summary: Several lines alter the source’s action or blunt the final reversal; other issues are localized wording.
